sayLines.line: 📓 Journal: the person in their 30s taught the woman in her 20s Herbal Medicine.
Meera is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
📓 Journal: the person in their 30s taught Meera Herbal Medicine.
Saul came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

◈ FLASHBACK — Reading Glasses
You read the fine print on medicine bottles for Jalen next door, because their hands shook. Dosages, warnings, the tiny words that matter. The apocalypse has fine print too.

Deeper knowledge: Lamb's Quarters. Uses: more nutritious than spinach. High in vitamins A and C. (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: spinach-like greens — cook to tame the oxalates; medicine: leaf poultice for bites and stings.
🎒 "Out past the ridge," Michelle says, already walking. "If I'm not back in a few days... well. I'll be back."
